title: Lor San Tekka's Last Stand
description: Kylo Ren does not have to search long to find Lor San Tekka. "You know what I've come for," Kylo tells the old man. "Give it to me." As San Tekka refuses to give up the information, Kylo draws his Lightsaber on him, threatening violence in exchange for the details of Luke Skywalker's whereabouts.
